items.title: Adobe’s Sam Garfield: AI has Sped Up Creative, But Organizations Haven’t Kept Pace
items.summary: RANCHO PALOS VERDES, CALIF. — Creative ideation that once took weeks now takes days, and sometimes hours. Versioning an asset across channels, formats, and aspect ratios has sped up just as much. The slowdown has moved somewhere else. According to Sam Garfield, head of Digital Strategy, CMT, Data and AI Platforms at Adobe, the friction now sits inside the enterprise operating model.
